sarah.intro: An elementary specialist who uses bright energy to help kids open up and start speaking.
sarah.detail: With over 10 years of experience teaching English to children, Sarah guides kids to build sentences on their own through step-by-step repeated practice, from phonics to reading. Her praise-and-encouragement teaching style is especially well suited for children starting video English for the first time.

james.intro: A secondary-school specialist who rapidly improves students' skills with logical, structured feedback.
james.detail: James teaches grammar correction, essay writing, and debate to secondary school and adult learners. Going beyond simple conversation, he provides precise, sentence-level feedback that strengthens both exam English and practical English at the same time.

emily.intro: A teacher who builds confidence with expressions you can use immediately in everyday life and at work.
emily.detail: Emily builds a customized curriculum around each adult learner's goals — travel, business, or everyday conversation. She emphasizes the courage to "just try speaking" over perfect sentences, correcting mistakes on the spot during class.
career: Graduate of University of Brighton, UK
Top Satisfaction Ratings from Adult Learners

daniel.intro: A teacher who builds the ability to think in English in a relaxed, comfortable atmosphere.
daniel.detail: Daniel excels at putting learners at ease with a cheerful, friendly teaching style. Through repeated Q&A practice that builds sentences on the spot, he sharpens students' quick thinking for real conversation situations.
career: 7 Years Teaching Video English to All Ages

learningSystem.title: Do You Know What Your Child Learned in Class Today?
learningSystem.description:
You don't need to watch every class to find out.

New words learned, sentences corrected, expressions mastered, progress made, and what still needs work —
we report on it as if we sat through the entire class with your child.

And at the end, a real note from their teacher, just for them.

When class ends, your child's whole day is right there for you to see.

classroom.title: My Classroom
classroom.desc: Manage class reschedules and video class entry all in one place. You can also instantly access past class replays and course materials.

report.title: Learning Evaluation Report
report.desc: Rather than a generic summary, we record specific details for every class — expressions learned, speaking participation, and areas needing correction.

levelcheck.title: Monthly Level Test
levelcheck.desc: Based on data accumulated each month, we provide a report on level changes and set the next learning goal together.

aboutTeaser.quote: "We grow through the results of our teaching and our customers' trust — not advertising."
aboutTeaser.quote_sub: This is the most important principle {{brandName}} has upheld for 12 years.
aboutTeaser.heading: English Education Optimized for EFL Learners — That Actually Works
aboutTeaser.paragraph1: Simply listening and reading a lot isn't enough to become fluent in English. Through interactive video English lessons with native and expert foreign teachers, {{brandName}} runs a program where learners immediately apply what they learn during class, naturally improving their listening and speaking skills in the process.
aboutTeaser.paragraph2: Rather than simply finishing a set textbook on schedule, we place the highest priority on building English learners can actually use — through repeated practice, Q&A, free conversation, sentence correction, and diverse feedback tailored to each learner's level and goals.
